item.title: Hartford police officer's shooting of man carrying knife ruled a homicide
item.description: The Connecticut Office of Inspector General released its preliminary report Friday, a week after a Hartford police officer fired nine shots at a man carrying a knife, which the office said resulted in his death.

item.title: Ex-New Haven police chief arraigned in $85,500 embezzlement case
item.description: Former New Haven Police Chief Karl Jacobson was arrested for allegedly embezzling $85,000 of city funds and is expected to be arraigned on Friday on two counts of first-degree larceny by defrauding a public community.
